verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The main success path is strongest: service-to-agent batching and compression, outage disk buffering and recovery drain, authenticated/rate-limited/schema-validated ingest, trace-ID partitioning into a durable log, assembly timing and parent-child restoration, post-assembly tail sampling, unbiased every-trace metrics, hot-to-cold aging, and saturation priority are all clearly represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: Several defining edge and failure semantics are absent, especially actionable malformed-batch rejection, oldest-first buffer overflow, late-span attachment without duplication, and selective cardinality quarantine.
verdict.coverage_summary: Weighted coverage is 51.5 of 68.0, or 0.7574. The board substantially represents the architecture and its principal outage, assembly, sampling, metrics, storage, and saturation flows. However, four system-defining behaviors are absent and several qualifiers are only partial, so the board cannot replace the brief as a complete visual acceptance record. The raw coverage maps to 6, and the absent-system-defining caps also limit the result to 6.
